title: Juicy Smoky Indian Tofu Biryani
description: A citrusy and crisp Indian dish featuring mirin and smoke, made with plant-based friendly ingredients, this biryani is a unique twist on traditional Hyderabadi cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides.
Add the mirin, smoked paprika, and garam masala, and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and rinsed basmati rice to the saucepan, and stir to combine with the tofu and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in the lime juice and chopped cilantro, and season with salt to taste.
Serve the biryani hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
